chapter.title: Act IV: The Longest Night
subtitle: Winter, Year One
Keep the valley warm and fed, and finish Josie's power plant.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

hover: Early winter, and it does not stop.
The Hearth went out on its own.
He will say no. Take it anyway.
The lake is a floor now.
One post stays bare on purpose.

quests.title: Sleep One Night, Then Follow Pip to the Inn
quests.subtitle: The Hearth has gone out. One of you sleeping is enough.
description: Pip, out of breath at your door: "The Hearth's out! It's been out since supper and Aunt Marnie is just standing there looking at it!"
Sleep one night in your own bed, then walk down to the &binn&r. Everyone is already inside it.
Winter opens. &aFirewood Bundles&r, a cloak and Marnie's cocoa come with it.

tasks.title: A night slept, and the whole valley already inside the inn

rewards.title: The Winter Book Opens
rewards.description: Next: 16 Firewood Bundles each to Marnie, Halden, Nella and Oda.

quests.title: Fill the Four Firewood Stacks, 16 Each
quests.subtitle: Marnie's, Halden's, Nella's and Oda's.
description: Oda, not looking up from the ledger: "Four houses, sixteen bundles each. That is sixty-four, which is exactly what you were given."
Put 16 &aFirewood Bundles&r into each of the four marked stacks in the inn's back room. Sixty-four is what Oda gave you and sixty-four is what winter costs — burn any of it and you are cutting more.
Each of them gives something back, and Wisp lights a lantern path down the frozen river.

rewards.title: Four Stacks Filled
rewards.description: Next: walk the frozen river down to the reeds and bring the Ribbits home.

quests.title: Walk the Frozen River, Bring the Ribbits Home
quests.subtitle: Follow Wisp's lanterns downstream and back.
description: Wisp: "The reeds is all ice now, and we are four with no roof. Can we be your neighbours nearer?"
Walk the frozen river down to the reed village and talk to Reed, Sedge, Mudlark and Puddle. They pack up and walk back on their own.
Four Ribbits move in for good, and Nella hands you her &aIce Auger&r. More frog folk: see &6The Wild&r.

tasks.title: Reach the reed village and walk the Ribbits back to the inn

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "Wisp lit the way. You walk it.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Four Ribbits, Moved In
rewards.description: Next: cook 12 Vegetable Soup for the long table. The Ice Auger goes through the lake whenever you want it.

quests.title: Cook 12 Vegetable Soup for the Long Table
quests.subtitle: One bowl for every seat.
description: Marnie, quietly: "I have fed this room for thirty years, and tonight I'm sitting down at it. Don't make a thing of it."
Cook 12 &aVegetable Soup&r in the Cooking Pot and set them on the long table at the inn.
The Hearth relights and Marnie sits down. More pots and pans: the &6Cooking and Brewing&r chapter.

rewards.title: The Hearth Is Lit Again
rewards.description: Next: glaze the greenhouse shell on the square. Six windows, a door and eight planters ride over in the soup crate.

quests.title: Cut the Ice for Muskellunge and Trout
quests.subtitle: Nella's Ice Auger goes through it.
description: Nella, flat: "Lake's a floor now, and the auger goes through it. Fish underneath don't know it's winter."
Cut a hole past the pier where the ice is dark, then catch 4 &aMuskellunge&r and 4 &aRainbow Trout&r through it. Bait the hook with a worm.
Winter tackle, and two mounts for the inn wall. More rods: the &6Animals and Fishing&r chapter.

quests.title: Brew 8 Winter Tonics, One Each
quests.subtitle: At Halden's still, west of the square.
description: Halden, slowly: "Eight people, eight bottles. I would go round myself, but they talk to you more than they talk to me."
Brew 8 &aWinter Tonics&r at Halden's still, west of the square. A Flask, a Green Tea Leaf and one sugar makes two.
Nobody in the valley gets sick this winter, and Halden stops being the only one who checks.

quests.title: Run 5 Parcels From the Delivery Crate
quests.subtitle: One click each — the crate fills them.
description: Pip: "I am the courier and the satchel has my name on it! Five parcels and then cocoa!"
Take 5 &aCourier Parcels&r out of the Delivery Crate beside Oda's board and run them. One click each now.
Pip keeps the satchel, and the duckling finishes growing up.

quests.title: Glaze the Greenhouse and Hang Its Door
quests.subtitle: 6 windows, a door, 8 planters on the bench.
description: Nella: "Nothing grows in it yet. I'll sit in it anyway — it's the only quiet room in town."
Put an &aOak Window&r in each of the six frames on the square, hang the &aOak Cottage Door&r, and set 8 Planters on the marked bench.
The shell becomes a room the coolant loop can heat. Growing in winter: the &6Farm and Seasons&r chapter.

tasks.title: Six windows in, door hung, eight planters on the bench

rewards.title: The Greenhouse Is Glazed
rewards.description: Next: dress the inn's twelve marked tiles for the solstice — a candle holder, a sconce and a flower box each.

quests.title: Dress the Inn's Twelve Solstice Tiles
quests.subtitle: A candle holder, a sconce and a flower box.
description: Marnie: "Twelve spots. The solstice is the solstice, even in a year like this one has been."
Set a &aCandle Holder&r, a &aSconce&r and a &aFlower Box&r on each of the twelve marked copper tiles in the inn.
Sixteen more of each come back, and Marnie's mulled cider goes on the hob.

tasks.title: All twelve marked copper tiles dressed

rewards.title: The Inn Is Dressed
rewards.description: Next: bake 4 Bread with Pip at the inn oven. He can reach if he stands on the stool.

quests.title: Bake 4 Bread With Pip at the Inn Oven
quests.subtitle: He can reach if he stands on the stool.
description: Pip: "I can reach if I stand on the stool! Aunt Marnie says I can reach and Aunt Marnie is right!"
Bake 4 &aBread&r at the inn's oven with Pip on the stool beside you.
You keep the loaf he made himself. It is not good. It is his.

rewards.title: Pip's Own Loaf
rewards.description: Next: shear the flock and make 3 Blankets. The loom, the shears and 24 wool came over with the bread.

quests.title: Shear the Flock and Make 3 Blankets
quests.subtitle: One blanket per empty house.
description: Marnie: "Three empty houses, three beds, three blankets. People arrive in spring, and beds should be made before they get here."
Shear the pasture flock for 24 wool, then craft 3 &aBlankets&r — eight wool around one string each.
Three beds made in three houses nobody lives in yet.

quests.title: Furnish the Bathhouse's Twelve Spots
quests.subtitle: Bram piped it and stopped there.
description: Bram: "Built it, piped it, didn't furnish it. That end's not mine."
Put an &aOak Bench&r, an &aOak Shelf&r and a &aLantern&r on each of the bathhouse's twelve marked spots, behind the inn.
Bram's waste heat becomes a room people sit in. More fittings: the &6Home and Town&r chapter.

tasks.title: Every marked spot in the bathhouse furnished

quests.title: Open the Works
quests.subtitle: Forty blocks of fall, then the Waystone.
description: Tobin, fast: "The fall is forty blocks of it, I paced it twice, and behind forty blocks is the entire works, and I have not slept."
Mine the 40 marked blocks out of the adit on the East Lane verge, drop into &bJosie's Works&r, and place the &aWaystone&r on the plinth inside.
The Works lights up. Her &aFlux Drill&r is on the bench, charged, and there is a saddled horse in the stable.

tasks.title: Adit cleared and the Works Waystone placed inside

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Four years I have known that boiler never cracked and never said so. Right — where do you want the duct.","italic":true}]
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"She left the adit breathing eleven years so the works would not damp out, and I noticed the warm grass in July.","italic":true}]
title @p subtitle {"text": "Forty blocks of fall, the works behind.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: The Works Is Open
rewards.description: Next: duct the mill to the Works, and take the new compass to the Wandering Merchant's Tower.

quests.title: Duct the Mill to the Works, Fit 2 Cells
quests.subtitle: Two Thermal Energy Cells at the Works end.
description: Bram: "Mill makes it, Works needs it, duct in between. You have done this once already."
Run &aEnergy Duct&r from the mill to the Works, then fit 2 &aEnergy Cells&r at the Works end of the line.
The Works has power. What &bRF&r is and where it goes: the &6Power and Logistics&r chapter.

tasks.title: Energy Duct run from the mill to the Works

rewards.title: The Works Has Power
rewards.description: Next: build a Molecular Assembler and a 4k Crafting Storage into the network at the Works.

quests.title: Fetch the Second Kettle Plate
quests.subtitle: The compass from the Works points at it.
description: Josie, in the margin: "Second plate went out with the tower trader. He always did want it more than he could read it."
Take the Explorer's Compass from the Works to the &bWandering Merchant's Tower&r, click the Waystone at its gate, and open the vault chest inside.
Josie's &aTurbine Notes&r come back with it, and reactor casings become craftable.

tasks.title: Vault chest open at the Wandering Merchant's Tower

rewards.command: execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Turbine Notes in Hand
rewards.description: Next: follow Josie's yellorite map from the Works Waystone and mine 64 uranium.

quests.title: Build a Molecular Assembler and 4k Storage
quests.subtitle: Into the ME network at the Works.
description: Tobin: "You can keep making casings by hand, or the network can while you eat. I recommend the network, strongly."
Craft 1 &aMolecular Assembler&r and 1 &a4k Crafting Storage&r and slot them into the ME network at the Works.
The network crafts while you eat. Patterns and wireless: the &6Storage Network&r chapter.

rewards.title: The Network Crafts It
rewards.description: Next: follow Josie's yellorite map, now in your bag, from the Works Waystone to the pocket.

quests.title: Mine 32 Uranium From Josie's Pocket
quests.subtitle: Her map starts at the Works Waystone.
description: Tobin: "Her map puts the pocket a fixed walk from the Works waystone. Josie's surveys have never once been wrong."

Follow Josie's map from the Works Waystone and mine 32 &aUranium&r. Every block drops a cluster and every cluster smelts one for one — a Redstone Furnace or Induction Smelter clears the lot in a minute. "Yellorium" is her shorthand.
Your own network auto-crafts 64 &aReactor Casings&r while you walk back.

rewards.title: 64 Casings, Auto-Crafted
rewards.description: Next: assemble the vessel — 64 casings, a terminal, 8 fuel rods, 4 control rods, an access port and 2 coolant ports.

quests.title: Build the Vessel
quests.subtitle: Four rod columns, two tall, on the pad.
description: Bram: "Shell, terminal, fuel rods, control rods, access port, two coolant ports. Build it square. Her drawing's on the wall behind you."
Assemble the vessel on the Works pad: 64 &aReactor Casings&r, 1 Terminal, 8 Fuel Rods, 4 Control Rods, 1 Access Port, 2 Coolant Ports. Without the coolant pair it runs passive.

A hollow box of casing with the ports in the walls, fuel rods standing floor to ceiling inside and a control rod on top of each column. The &bReactor Terminal&r tells you what is wrong. Bram's turbine crate comes back with it — see &6The Reactor and the Quarry&r.

tasks.title: Vessel assembled and reading valid on the terminal

rewards.title: The Vessel Is Square
rewards.description: Next: build the turbine out of Bram's crate and hold 1,800 RPM under load.

quests.title: Tune the Turbine to 1,800 RPM
quests.subtitle: Hold it there, then /valley check turbine.
description: Bram: "Crate's got what it's got — blades, coils, casing. Get it to eighteen hundred RPM under load and hold it there."

Build the turbine from that crate: 64 &aTurbine Casing&r, 16 Glass, 2 Rotor Bearings one at each end, 6 Shafts, 16 Blades, 2 Fluid Ports and 16 copper blocks for the coil ring. Bram's crate builds the big one; the &6Reactor&r chapter builds the small 5x5x4 on four blades, and the two are not interchangeable.
RPM is a balance, not a switch: &bmore steam speeds it, more blades or more coil blocks slow it&r. Open the flow a little at a time.

Press &bT&r and type &b/valley check turbine&r to read RPM, steam in and power out. It settles in about three passes. Josie's field notes f6 and f7 are in the &aValley Journal&r, and &6The Reactor and the Quarry&r chapter builds one from scratch.

rewards.title: 1,800 RPM, Held
rewards.description: Next: run the coolant loop out to the six greenhouse heaters and the bathhouse tank.

quests.title: Duct the Coolant Loop to the Town
quests.subtitle: Josie's rule: the heat goes to the town.
description: Josie, in her own hand: "The waste heat goes to the town, not the sky. Anything else is a fire you paid for twice."
Run &aFluid Duct&r and &aEnergy Duct&r from the reactor to the six greenhouse heaters on the square, and to the bathhouse tank behind the inn.
Six heaters come up warm, the tank steams, and the glass lights itself.

tasks.title: All 6 greenhouse heaters connected and running

rewards.title: Glass That Lights Itself
rewards.description: Next: furnish the bathhouse's twelve marked spots. Its benches, shelves and lanterns are already in your bag.

quests.title: Bring Bram to the Inn With a Hot Cocoa
quests.subtitle: He will say no. Take the cocoa anyway.
description: Marnie: "He'll say the mill needs him at midnight in January. Take the cocoa anyway, and don't argue with him about it."
Walk to the mill, click Bram for his token, and hand him 1 &aHot Cocoa&r.
He says no, puts his tools down, and walks down with you. His father's wrench is yours.

rewards.title: Bram Sits Down
rewards.description: Next: hand Bram the lever, once Tobin has signed off the three numbers.

quests.title: Run the Line, Mill to Square to Lake
quests.subtitle: Twenty-nine posts. Lamps 39 of 40.
description: Josie, page forty: "Forty posts, mill to square to lake. I counted them on my fingers before I could count to forty."
Walk the whole line and run the duct along it — mill, square, lake, farm gate, past all twenty-nine posts still off the grid.
&bLamps 39 of 40&r. One post stays bare on purpose: the one on Josie's porch.

tasks.title: All 29 marked lamp posts placed, mill to square to lake

rewards.title: Lamps 39 / 40
rewards.description: Next: read fuel, coolant and rods off the Reactor Terminal, then hand Bram the lever.

quests.title: Read the Three Numbers, Hand Over the Lever
quests.subtitle: Act IV finale — the Longest Night.
description: Tobin, calm for once: "Fuel, coolant, rods — I check them, I sign it, Bram pulls it. That's the order, and I wrote it down twice."
Open the &bReactor Terminal&r in the Works, read fuel level, coolant flow and control-rod insertion off its screen, then hand Bram the lever.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

tasks.title: Fuel, coolant and rods read off the terminal

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"One hundred Scrip against your name. I have never written a number that large in this book, so I wrote it twice.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Longest Night
rewards.description: Next: sleep one night, then walk the square with Marnie. Tobin wants a second turbine off the same reactor.
